data.long_meaning: The name Sharang means 'Protector, Guardian'. This powerful name is derived from the Sanskrit language and has its roots in Hinduism. It is a name for a strong and courageous individual, who is known to protect and shield those around him. The name Sharang carries the meaning “Protector, Guardian” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sharang usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharang is a name that signifies protection and safety. It is believed to be a name of the god Shiva, who is the protector and guardian of the universe. The name is often chanted during times of distress to seek his blessings and protection.
data.etymology: Sharang belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector, Guardian.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharang total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sharang holds a significant cultural impact in Hinduism. It refers to a powerful deity or god, Sharang Dev, who is one of the eight manifestations of Lord Hanuman. This deity is also known as the remover of sorrows and is worshipped for peace, prosperity, and protection. The name Sharang symbolizes strength, courage, and guardianship, values that are highly revered in Hindu culture.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Sharang signifies the divine protector within us all. It reminds us of the infinite power and the courage that resides in every individual, and encourages us to tap into that inner strength to overcome challenges and keep our loved ones safe. The name is a call to action, inspiring us to be guardians of our own lives and the lives of those around us, and to seek refuge in the protective embrace of the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sharang: The name Sharang symbolizes the protective shield of the divine elephant God Ganesha, bestowing strength, wisdom, and the ability to overcome obstacles. It is a reminder to carry the blessings of wisdom and strength within.

historical_references.context: Yakshas are nature deities in Hinduism.

The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
